title: English Vocabulary — Set 1
subject: English (Class 6–7)
description: Each word climbs boxes: recognise the meaning → pick it in a sentence → type it → use it yourself. Missed words come back soon; known words come back days later.

CARD_ABUNDANT.title: abundant
CARD_ABUNDANT.body:
**abundant** *(adjective)*

**Meaning:** existing in large amounts; more than enough

**Example:** Mangoes are abundant in summer.

**हिंदी:** प्रचुर, भरपूर

CARD_FRAGILE.title: fragile
CARD_FRAGILE.body:
**fragile** *(adjective)*

**Meaning:** easily broken or damaged

**Example:** Handle the glass bangles carefully — they are fragile.

**हिंदी:** नाज़ुक

CARD_RELUCTANT.title: reluctant
CARD_RELUCTANT.body:
**reluctant** *(adjective)*

**Meaning:** unwilling and slow to do something

**Example:** Meena was reluctant to jump into the cold river.

**हिंदी:** अनिच्छुक

CARD_CURIOUS.title: curious
CARD_CURIOUS.body:
**curious** *(adjective)*

**Meaning:** wanting to know or learn about something

**Example:** The curious child asked how rainbows form.

**हिंदी:** जिज्ञासु

CARD_GENEROUS.title: generous
CARD_GENEROUS.body:
**generous** *(adjective)*

**Meaning:** happy to give more money, time or help than expected

**Example:** Our generous neighbour shared sweets with the whole street.

**हिंदी:** उदार

CARD_ANCIENT.title: ancient
CARD_ANCIENT.body:
**ancient** *(adjective)*

**Meaning:** very old; from a long time ago

**Example:** Hampi has many ancient temples.

**हिंदी:** प्राचीन

CARD_BRIEF.title: brief
CARD_BRIEF.body:
**brief** *(adjective)*

**Meaning:** lasting only a short time; short

**Example:** The principal gave a brief speech.

**हिंदी:** संक्षिप्त

CARD_ENORMOUS.title: enormous
CARD_ENORMOUS.body:
**enormous** *(adjective)*

**Meaning:** extremely large

**Example:** An elephant is an enormous animal.

**हिंदी:** विशाल

CARD_RAPID.title: rapid
CARD_RAPID.body:
**rapid** *(adjective)*

**Meaning:** happening very quickly; fast

**Example:** The town saw rapid growth after the new railway line.

**हिंदी:** तीव्र, तेज़

CARD_VIVID.title: vivid
CARD_VIVID.body:
**vivid** *(adjective)*

**Meaning:** very bright, clear or detailed

**Example:** She described her dream in vivid detail.

**हिंदी:** सजीव, चटकीला

CARD_HUMBLE.title: humble
CARD_HUMBLE.body:
**humble** *(adjective)*

**Meaning:** not proud; not thinking you are better than others

**Example:** Despite winning, the champion stayed humble.

**हिंदी:** विनम्र

CARD_GLOOMY.title: gloomy
CARD_GLOOMY.body:
**gloomy** *(adjective)*

**Meaning:** dark or sad; without hope

**Example:** The sky was gloomy before the storm.

**हिंदी:** उदास, अंधकारमय
